statement: ∀ (A D : ℝ≥0∞), D ≠ ⊤ → (∀ q : ℝ, D.toReal < q → A ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (q+1)) → A ≤ D + 1
proof:
intro A D hD h
have hb := h (D.toReal + 1) (by linarith)
have hA : A ≠ ⊤ := ne_top_of_le_ne_top ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top hb
have hreal : A.toReal ≤ D.toReal + 1 := by
  apply le_of_forall_gt_imp_ge_of_dense
  intro r hr
  have hq : D.toReal < r - 1 := by linarith
  have hpos : 0 ≤ r := by have := ENNReal.toReal_nonneg (a := D); linarith
  have hh : A ≤ ENNReal.ofReal r := by simpa using h (r - 1) hq
  simpa [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal hpos] using ENNReal.toReal_mono ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top hh
have hconvert : ENNReal.ofReal (D.toReal + 1) = D + 1 := by
  rw [ENNReal.ofReal_add ENNReal.toReal_nonneg (by norm_num), ENNReal.ofReal_toReal hD]
  norm_num
rw [← hconvert, ← ENNReal.ofReal_toReal hA]
exact ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal hreal
